name: Tales from the Solstice
description: A sweeping 3-disc symphonic rock opera uniting two survivors across a decade. Originally forged on December 11, 1996 in Ewell, Virginia, 'Upon This Winter's Night' was recorded in a spare bedroom and broadcast across the Appalachian radio towers by Gabriel and Gwendolyn Rowlands and twins Maria and Clara Harrison to guide their fourteen-year-old brother Julian ('Julep') home from his abduction to Ohio. Ten years later, after learning that their 1997 single served as the 'Sonic Armor' that grounded nineteen-year-old Matthew during his cross-country abduction from Norfolk to Seattle and rescue by Jyn, Samantha bought out Vanguard Horizon's vaults—commissioning the family to compose the 3-disc rock opera telling Matthew's cross-country ordeal and liberating Julian's vaulted Trilingual 'Family Mix' (Cymraeg, Québécois French, and US English).
